Jules (CSM): Morning — scheduling a final bring-up rehearsal for CypressAI's dedicated pool. Need signoff on quota, autoscale headroom, and the load script mapping to their traffic. Proposing Wed 09:00 UTC for a 45m window. Can we confirm?
Omar (Solutions Eng): Wed 09:00 UTC ok for me. Plan: quick auth check (5m), priming (10m), staged ramp (25m), short fallback test (5m). Will reuse our lightweight loader but with their real prompt distribution.
Nina (Eng Infra): I can make Wed. Notes: we'll carve out a reserved pool of 4x H100 + 2x A100 for mixed-profile tests. Autoscale will be enabled but with a soft upper limit of 10 nodes for the rehearsal to avoid unexpected spend. We'll also enable detailed tracing at the model layer during the soak.
Kai - CypressAI: Wed works. A few asks from our side: 1) We need a documented fallback that our SREs can trigger if p95 > 1.0s for >60s. 2) Can you provide the expected cost delta so we can route budget approval? 3) Will you capture any sample outputs so our QA team can validate correctness?
Omar (Solutions Eng): For fallback we can set a rehearsal-only route rule: if p95 > 1.0s for 60s flip traffic to `hosted-stable`. I'll include a one-liner to run from your ops shell. Cost delta: rough estimate = +$0.12 per 1k tokens under load (we'll produce a tighter number after the smoke). We'll definitely capture sample responses and ship them to your QA.
Nina (Eng Infra): Priming recommendation: run top-100 prefix primes with 10 concurrent clients for 10 minutes prior to ramp. I'll provision the pool by Tue EOD and post the pool id here. Also, I'll pin quantization profile to q4_0 for this rehearsal to keep latency predictable.
Jules (CSM): Checklist I'm tracking:
- Reserved pool provisioned (Nina)
- Autoscale soft cap set (Nina)
- k6 load + prompt distribution shared (Omar)
- Fallback CLI + runbook (Omar + Jules)
- QA output capture enabled (Omar)
- Customer-side probe pre-check (Kai)
Please confirm owners and target EOD Monday to lock in.
Kai - CypressAI: We'll run an endpoint connectivity probe Mon 08:00 UTC for 10m. Also we'll need the exact k6 variables so we can simulate our bursty daytime pattern — mostly 20-60 concurrent users with 3 token tiers.
Omar (Solutions Eng): k6 snippet and env vars (example):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ prompt: randomPrompt(), max_tokens: __ENV.TOKENS });
  http.post('https://dedicated.redwood/api/v1/generate', payload, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${__ENV.TOKEN}` } });
}
```
Ramp: 10 -> 120 VUs over 20m, then maintain 120 for 20m, then graceful drain. We'll also run a 1% noise of very-large-token requests.
Nina (Eng Infra): Fallback CLI (for rehearsal): `redwood route switch --team cypressai --from dedicated-cypress --to hosted-stable --reason "rehearsal failover"`. We'll gate the command with a two-person approval for safety.
Jules (CSM): Good. Kai — will your SREs be the ones to run the fallback if needed or should we handle it?
Kai - CypressAI: We'll take the first try, but want Redwood on standby. Please include phone numbers/email for on-call.
deploy-bot: Event created: "CypressAI Dedicated Rehearsal" Wed 1717769280 09:00 UTC. Reminder 15m before. Organizer: Jules (CSM).
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the k6 repo and a sample prompt set to: https://drive.redwood/cypressai/rehearsal. Also adding automated log export during soak (error traces + p95 buckets).
Nina (Eng Infra): I'll post the reserved pool id and autoscale snapshot here when done (target Tue 18:00 UTC). Will also attach the temporary tracing dashboard link.
Jules (CSM): I'll prepare a two-slide summary for the renewal meeting showing expected p95 and estimated cost impact. Owners confirmed: Nina (pool + autoscale), Omar (load + fallback + logs), Kai (customer probe + ops), Jules (runbook + renewal slide).
Kai - CypressAI: Thanks team — we'll do pre-probe Mon 08:00, rehearsal Wed 09:00-09:45 UTC. Please ping if anything changes.
Omar (Solutions Eng): One last note: capture a set of golden outputs (10 prompts) during the ramp and during the soak so QA can compare for regressions.
Jules (CSM): Locked in. I'll follow up Friday with any outstanding items. Closing thread unless someone needs to add follow-ups.
